title: Respicio takes ‘extensive’ P28,000 drug test after Remulla remark

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Isabela Vice Mayor Jeryll Harold Respicio underwent a P28,000 drug test at a private hospital after Interior Secretary Jonvic Remula said he wanted him tested following his outburst during a council session. “Pinaka-extensive na drug test yung pinake ko, may qualitative and may quantitative. So kakakuha lang ng sample sa akin and in 15 minutes lalabas na po yung qualitative results. And in two hours lalabas na rin po yung qualitative results,” said in a phone interview with reporters on Wednesday.
